notes: DirectConnect: the instructions for changing a sensor are now the same everywhere in Loop. Insert the new sensor, then delete the old CGM (Settings → CGM → Delete CGM), add Dexcom G7/ONE+ using DirectConnect, and enter the new sensor's 4-digit pairing code. The sensor screen now shows time left in hours and minutes during the last day, instead of rounding up to whole hours. The installer (Option B) now works with Loop 3.14.11.
